auditor.method: Immutable packet hashes verified first as requested, then exact source and every required r23 orbit, rear clay, and phone raster inspected at native pixels.

exactSource.scope: Royal Palace is judged against directly visible architecture. Satellite role identity is judged against the exact source panels: Hatchery egg/nursery, Habit bee-in-honeycomb pollination, Wisdom honeycomb plus open book, and Arena crossed mallets.

evidencePacket.integrity: PASS: source, runtime, all six declared runtime dependencies, every SVG, and every raster independently matched the manifest hashes.

authority.evidenceMethod: CPU triangle projection of actual Three.js meshes, exact canonical 36-tile transforms/geometry, and InstancedMesh transforms; materials approximated without WebGL.
authority.evidenceLimit: Valid for geometry, silhouette, placement, occlusion, mechanism visibility, and phone composition. It does not reproduce physical refraction, environment reflections, post-processing, HUD/controller overlays, or GPU transparency ordering.

buildings.name: Royal Palace

viewScores.finding: Purple portal, cupola cluster, dark open lantern, gold honeycomb lattice, and orange dome create clear royal hierarchy. It remains substantially simpler and less inhabited than the exact source's dense multi-tower jewel-hive cathedral.
Dark lantern and facade detail survive; broad pale roof and wall planes still simplify the source.
The side has real dark-lantern architecture, cupolas, and windows, but the lower mass remains broad and plain and loses the source's clustered-bay silhouette.
Rear door, cupolas, windows, and lantern depth are authored; the rear is still one wide wall below a single tower. Clay confirms complete geometry but not source-density parity.
The weakest profile remains sparse and planar beneath the stronger dark lantern.
Portal, cupolas, and honeycomb lantern restore the strong front-oblique read, with limited continuous filigree.
The entire island now fits; palace dome, dark lattice, cupolas, and purple door remain readable, though at smaller scale than r19.

buildings.verdict: Stable; phone reframing does not resolve the structural source-parity gap.

buildings.name: Queen's Nursery

viewScores.finding: Broad egg, crown/bee crest, purple door, honeycomb cells, and brood pod remain clearly distinct.
Only the upper egg/crown portion clears the palace. Door, pods, foundation, and enough complete mass to guarantee nursery identity remain occluded.
Egg, attached pod, crown, and entry contrast are strongly readable behind the palace.
Complete near view with broad egg, pod, crown, crest, cells, and doorway.
The strongest nursery view retains full authored mass and distinct brood identity.
The nursery remains identifiable at the left edge, though some outer mass is cropped by the desktop frame.
Unlike r19, the upper egg, crown, doorway contrast, and enough of the brood mass are inside the phone viewport. Fine cells and pod depth remain small.

buildings.occlusionComparison: Phone clipping is resolved, but the governing 045 palace occlusion is essentially unchanged.

buildings.name: Pollinator Yard

viewScores.finding: Raised orange/striped rotor is visible beside the palace, while broad workyard and planters still merge into terrain.
Taller mechanism and cross-axis frame produce a purposeful pollination device, but a narrow rather than broad yard silhouette.
Mechanism is exposed left of the palace and maintains solid 360 volume; honeycomb/bee role remains modest.
Upper rotor/halo now peeks clearly left of the palace; most court geometry remains hidden.

The r19 disappearance is resolved: a full-height orange rotor/halo silhouette is visible between palace and Trials. It still reads more as a narrow orange mechanism than an unmistakable bee-in-honeycomb workyard.
Raised mechanism is clearly present beside the palace, though court and planters remain weak.
The full orange mechanism is now inside the phone viewport, but honeycomb halo, bee center, and yard program are too small for confident role recognition.

buildings.occlusionComparison: Resolved as visibility: Pollinator no longer disappears at 270. Not resolved as source-role clarity or phone readability.

buildings.name: Hive Archives

viewScores.finding: Monumental open-book roof, purple pages, arched door, and shelf windows remain immediately distinct.
Book silhouette, crown, and side hall hold from the oblique.
Open-book crest survives at distance while shelf and entry details weaken.
Rear book/crown/door program and solid depth remain authored; clay shows no rear collapse.
Large purple pages, wisdom crown, deep doorway, and honeycomb windows produce a strong near view.
Open-book silhouette remains dominant and unmistakable.
The r19 left-edge sliver is resolved: book roof, purple pages, wisdom crest, and part of the reading hall are inside the phone viewport. Fine doorway and shelf detail remain small.

buildings.clippingComparison: Resolved. Archives is fully role-readable on phone, though still below the 8.5 intended-scale threshold.

buildings.name: Nectar Trials

viewScores.finding: Enlarged hammer solids remain above the purple canopy; mechanism is visible but the overlapping blocks do not form a crisp crossed-mallet icon.
Near view confirms the hammers are not buried and the arena is structurally complete.
Raised mechanism remains above the ring from the side.
Hammer solids and oculus are visible from behind; clay confirms real 360 geometry, with crossed-tool silhouette still ambiguous.
Arena and raised mechanism remain visible behind the Pollinator without disappearing.
Pale hammer solids survive on the right, still weaker than the source Arena panel's clean crossed-mallet symbol.
The r19 right-edge sliver is resolved: purple arena ring and raised pale hammer mass are inside the phone viewport. The individual crossed hammers remain too small and visually merged.

buildings.clippingComparison: Resolved. Trials is present on phone again; source-defining crossed-hammer clarity remains incomplete.

phoneFraming.finding: The full island is scaled within the portrait viewport. Archives and Trials are no longer reduced to edge slivers; Nursery and Pollinator are also present.

queenNurseryOcclusion.finding: The 045 view still exposes only a partial upper egg/crown behind the palace.

pollinatorOcclusion.finding: The raised orange rotor/halo is now visible at 270, but remains weak in source-role and phone clarity.

trialsHammers.status: phone clipping resolved; icon clarity not resolved
trialsHammers.finding: The raised hammer mass is inside the phone frame and visible in every orbit, but does not yet read as a crisp pair of crossed mallets.

overallVerdict.finding: r23 successfully repairs r19's phone clipping and removes Pollinator's complete 270 disappearance. It still does not pass the final all-view building gate: Nursery remains strongly occluded at 045, Pollinator and Trials do not preserve source-role clarity on phone, Archives phone detail is below intended-scale threshold, and Palace profile/source parity remains structural.
